purpose: Teach: 太る/引っかかる/ほた/スミマセン/ひねり/広々/昇っ/すれ違う

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「最近、太る一方だ」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said the other day that he's been putting on weight lately.
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. A small smile in the voice — not mean, just wry observation. Casual pacing, like she's recounting something amusing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの服が枝に引っかかるところを見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Grandpa's clothes get caught on a branch!
lines.style: Bright, almost bursting with the detail he's just noticed. Quick delivery, pitched high with the excitement of having something to report. Eager to see if she thinks it's as interesting as he does.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが「ほた、いい天気だ」と仰ったわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather said it was nice weather — such a simple thing to notice.
lines.style: Soft, gentle reflection. Slight pause before the second part, letting the observation settle. Warm but thoughtful, like she's turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「スミマセン」って何度も言ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I kept saying sorry to Grandpa — over and over.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere intensity. A little breathless with the weight of it. Not defensive — more like he's telling her something that mattered, that he took seriously. Slight catch at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお話に、ひねりがあったわね
lines.en: Sho, there was something clever about the way your grandfather told that story.
lines.style: Gentle recognition. A knowing tone — she's seeing something layered in what happened. Slower pace, warm and slightly amused at something only she might have caught.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、新しいお家、広々していて気持ちいいよ
lines.en: Mom, the new house feels so open and nice.
lines.style: Bright and contented. A lighter, happier note than before. Simple pleasure in the observation — he's noticing the space around him, the good feeling of it. Warm and settled.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが階段を昇っていらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, I saw your grandfather climbing the stairs.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost matter-of-fact but with underlying tenderness. No rush. Like she's marking a small moment — the fact of him moving through the house, present and doing ordinary things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと最後にすれ違う前、手を振ったよ
lines.en: Mom, before we passed by each other for the last time, I waved at Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft, tender. A small vulnerability in the voice — the significance of that wave held gently. Slow, deliberate pace. Like he's telling her something he wanted her to know mattered.
